nodes.name: Execute Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes:
Triggered by WF-CR03A Submit (fire-and-forget). Expected input:
{ job_id: UUID, case_id: BIGINT }

parameters.query:
UPDATE car_cr03_jobs
   SET status = 'running', started_at = NOW()
 WHERE job_id = '{{ $json.job_id }}'
RETURNING job_id, case_id;

SELECT
    c.case_id,
    c.applicant_type,
    c.applicant_id,
    c.licence_target,
    c.status,
    c.created_at,
    c.primary_contact_name AS applicant_name,
    c.primary_contact_email AS applicant_email,
    c.intake_data,

    ck.raw_result                   AS kyc_result,
    ck.kyc_provider                 AS kyc_provider,
    ck.checked_at                   AS kyc_checked_at,

    cra.analysis_json               AS reference_analysis,

    ra1.report                      AS ra01_report,
    ra2.report                      AS ra02_report,
    ra3.report                      AS ra03_report,
    ra4.report                      AS ra04_report,
    ra5.report                      AS ra05_report,
    ra6.report                      AS ra06_report,

    COALESCE(json_agg(DISTINCT cm.analysis_json) FILTER (WHERE cm.analysis_json IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS meeting_analyses,
    COALESCE(json_agg(DISTINCT cd.metadata) FILTER (WHERE cd.metadata IS NOT NULL AND cd.status = 'received'), '[]') AS documents,

    gi.required_inputs,
    gi.gate_triggered_at

FROM car_cases c
LEFT JOIN car_case_kyc ck               ON ck.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN car_case_reference_analysis cra ON cra.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra1               ON ra1.case_id = c.case_id AND ra1.agent = 'RA-01'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra2               ON ra2.case_id = c.case_id AND ra2.agent = 'RA-02'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra3               ON ra3.case_id = c.case_id AND ra3.agent = 'RA-03'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra4               ON ra4.case_id = c.case_id AND ra4.agent = 'RA-04'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra5               ON ra5.case_id = c.case_id AND ra5.agent = 'RA-05'
LEFT JOIN car_case_ra ra6               ON ra6.case_id = c.case_id AND ra6.agent = 'RA-06'
LEFT JOIN car_case_meetings cm          ON cm.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN car_case_documents cd         ON cd.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN car_case_gate_inputs gi       ON gi.case_id = c.case_id

WHERE c.case_id = {{ $json.case_id }}
GROUP BY
    c.case_id, c.applicant_type, c.applicant_id, c.licence_target, c.status,
    c.created_at, c.primary_contact_name, c.primary_contact_email, c.intake_data,
    ck.raw_result, ck.kyc_provider, ck.checked_at,
    cra.analysis_json,
    ra1.report, ra2.report, ra3.report, ra4.report, ra5.report, ra6.report,
    gi.required_inputs, gi.gate_triggered_at;

   SET status = 'failed',
       attempt = {{ $json.attempt }},
       error = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.validation_errors).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
       completed_at = NOW()
 WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Postgres: Mark Job Running').first().json.job_id }}';

nodes.name: Postgres: Mark Job Failed
nodes.notes:
PLAN.md: "if still fails, save raw output and escalate to AI engineer."
The raw cr03_raw_response is not persisted here to keep this query simple
— extend if you want the full raw payload retained for escalation.

nodes.name: Code: Render Report 2 Markdown
nodes.notes:
Follows PLAN.md's Report 2 presentation standard: recommendation table,
legend, executive summary before dense detail, detailed-assessment table,
conditions table, annexes for flags/outstanding items, sources-reviewed
table. PDF rendering (generate_report2_pdf.py) remains a manual step —
see SETUP.md.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO car_case_dd_report (
    case_id,
    fund_risk_summary,
    executive_summary,
    risk_rating,
    fund_specific_findings,
    red_flags,
    orange_flags,
    outstanding_items,
    recommended_decision,
    conditions,
    rationale,
    cr03_raw_response,
    cr05_raw_response,
    report_md_path,
    report_json_path,
    model_used,
    input_token_count,
    output_token_count,
    authorisation_sought,
    fit_and_proper_assessment,
    fund_specific_findings_struct,
    assumed_undertakings,
    supervision_recommendations,
    sources_reviewed,
    generation_method
) VALUES (
    {{ $json.case_id }},
    {{ $json.fund_risk_summary ? JSON.stringify($json.fund_risk_summary) + "'::jsonb" : 'NULL' }},
    '{{ $json.dd_report.executive_summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.dd_report.risk_rating }}',
    {{ $json.dd_report.fund_specific_findings ? "'" + JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.fund_specific_findings).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.red_flags).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.orange_flags).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.outstanding_items).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ $json.dd_report.recommended_decision }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.conditions || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ $json.dd_report.rationale.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.cr03_raw_response).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    {{ $json.cr05_raw_response ? "'" + JSON.stringify($json.cr05_raw_response).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb" : 'NULL' }},
    '{{ $json.report_path }}',
    '{{ $json.report_json_path }}',
    'gemini-2.5-flash',
    {{ $json.input_token_count || 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.output_token_count || 'NULL' }},
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.authorisation_sought).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    {{ $json.dd_report.fit_and_proper_assessment ? "'" + JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.fit_and_proper_assessment).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.dd_report.fund_specific_findings ? "'" + JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.fund_specific_findings).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb" : 'NULL' }},
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.assumed_undertakings || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.supervision_recommendations).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.dd_report.sources_reviewed).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    'wf_cr03_async_full'
)
RETURNING report_id;

   SET status = 'complete',
       report_id = '{{ $('Postgres: Save DD Report').first().json.report_id }}',
       attempt = {{ $('Code: Render Report 2 Markdown').first().json.attempt }},
